E-001.threat: Privilege escalation via process vulnerability — attacker gains elevated privileges through process flaw
E-001.cause: Insufficient input validation or privilege boundary enforcement in the process
E-001.attack: Attacker exploits a process vulnerability to execute code or trigger operations with elevated privileges

E-002.threat: Insecure direct object reference — attacker accesses unauthorized resources via manipulated references
E-002.cause: Process does not validate that the caller is authorized to access the referenced object
E-002.attack: Attacker manipulates object references in process requests to access unauthorized data or functions

E-003.threat: Privilege escalation via environment manipulation — attacker modifies process environment
E-003.cause: Process relies on environment variables or configuration that can be modified by lower-privileged callers
E-003.attack: Attacker modifies environment variables or shared libraries to inject code that executes with elevated privileges

E-004.threat: System privilege escalation — attacker gains system-level privileges
E-004.cause: Insufficient privilege separation — a lower-privileged component can trigger system-level operations
E-004.attack: Attacker exploits a privilege boundary violation to execute operations with system-level authority
